stories.title: Prise de parole de Lecornu, appel à manifester des syndicats en soutien au mouvement lycéen, prix Nobel de chimie… L’actu de ce mercredi 7 octobre

en.title: Lecornu's statement, union calls for demonstrations in support of student movement, chemistry Nobel Prize… Wednesday October 7 news
en.summary: Libération reports on major news from Wednesday October 7, including remarks by Lecornu, union-organized demonstrations supporting a student movement, and the chemistry Nobel Prize announcement.

stories.title: OnlyFans et Mym dans le collimateur : pourquoi l’article 25 de la loi intégrale contre les violences sexuelles fait débat

en.title: OnlyFans and Mym under scrutiny: why Article 25 of the comprehensive law against sexual violence is sparking debate
en.summary: French lawmakers debate a provision classifying assistance in remote paid sexual acts as pimping, with opposition from left and center deputies and sex worker advocacy groups.

stories.title: Violences sexuelles en ligne : deux hommes arrêtés pour avoir diffusé les photos et vidéos intimes de 17 000 femmes, dont des mineures

en.title: Online sexual violence: two men arrested for distributing intimate photos and videos of 17,000 women, including minors
en.summary: Police arrested two brothers aged 21 and 25 from northern France after shutting down three websites used to distribute intimate images of 17,000 women and girls.

stories.title: Trois ans après le 7-Octobre, le poids du traumatisme dans la société israélienne

en.title: Three years after October 7, the weight of trauma in Israeli society
en.summary: Three years after the October 7 attacks that killed nearly 1,200 people, an analysis examines how the trauma continues to affect Israeli society and its residents.

stories.title: Trois ans après le 7-Octobre, Israël rend hommage aux 1 200 victimes

en.title: Three years after October 7, Israel pays tribute to 1,200 victims
en.summary: Israel commemorates the approximately 1,200 people killed in the October 7 Hamas attacks and reflects on the national trauma and its consequences for society.

stories.title: Le prix Nobel de chimie 2026 décerné au Français Henri Kagan et au Japonais Kenso Soai pour leurs travaux sur les réactions moléculaires utilisées notamment en pharmacologie

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry awarded to Frenchman Henri Kagan and Japanese Kenso Soai for their work on molecular reactions used notably in pharmacology
en.summary: Henri Kagan and Kenso Soai won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for discovering nonlinear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.

stories.title: Prix Nobel de chimie 2026 : le Français Henri Kagan récompensé

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Chemistry: Frenchman Henri Kagan honored
en.summary: Henri Kagan and Japanese colleague Kenso Soai received the prize for research on molecules existing in two symmetric versions, explaining why only one appears in living organisms.

stories.title: "Soudainement, tu te figes" : trois ans après le 7-Octobre, Omer Shem Tov, ancien otage du Hamas, reste hanté par sa captivité

en.title: "Suddenly, you freeze": three years after October 7, Omer Shem Tov, former Hamas hostage, remains haunted by his captivity
en.summary: Omer Shem Tov, released after 505 days in Gaza captivity, is reconstructing his life but continues to experience trauma from his detention. Three years after October 7, the former hostage hopes to be known for more than his experience as a hostage.

stories.title: À Gaza, trois ans après le 7 Octobre, les vivants et les morts restent prisonniers des ruines

en.title: In Gaza, three years after October 7, the living and the dead remain prisoners of the ruins
en.summary: A year after the October 10, 2025 ceasefire, Gaza families live in tents or weakened buildings with reconstruction stalled. Israeli restrictions and the impasse between Israel and Hamas continue to block rebuilding efforts.

stories.title: Trois ans après le 7 Octobre, Israël miné par le deuil, la guerre et les divisions

en.title: Three years after October 7, Israel weakened by mourning, war and divisions
en.summary: As Israel approaches its first elections since the massacre, initial unity following the shock has fractured into longstanding divisions. The conflict, exhaustion, and lack of official accountability have deepened these rifts.

stories.title: En Israël, trois ans après le 7-Octobre, les traumatismes et les aveuglements d’un pays

en.title: In Israel, three years after October 7, the trauma and blindness of a nation
en.summary: Israel commemorates victims of the October 7 Hamas attack during an election campaign while pursuing an ongoing war driven by revenge without examining the failures that led to the disaster.

stories.title: La Roumanie commande 12 H225M à Airbus

en.title: Romania orders 12 H225M from Airbus
en.summary: Romania's government signed a contract on October 7 to purchase 12 H225M helicopters from Airbus, following a previous order placed in June.

stories.title: Sophie Adenot et son équipage ont quitté l’ISS

en.title: Sophie Adenot and her crew left the ISS
en.summary: The Crew Dragon spacecraft carrying astronaut Sophie Adenot and the Crew-12 team departed the International Space Station on October 7, with return to Earth scheduled for the following day.

stories.title: Chine : Šefčovič négocie, Macron et Merz préparent la riposte

en.summary: The EU trade commissioner visits Beijing on October 8-9 to seek sectoral concessions, while France and Germany push for mechanisms to restrict market access more quickly.

en.title: OPINION. "Addiction Care Centers and legal remedies: time for the hearing", by Jean-François Corty, president of Doctors of the World
en.summary: Addiction Care Centers have proven effective but remain limited to pilot status; Paris administrative court will hear a legal challenge on October 8 filed against government inaction by advocacy organizations.

stories.title: OPINION. « Le tourisme est le laboratoire européen de l’IA agentique souveraine »

en.title: OPINION. "Tourism is the European laboratory for sovereign agentic AI"
en.summary: According to a Digital New Deal think tank representative, agentic AI represents the next digital architecture for the economy. Europe's tourism sector could be among the first to benefit through shared data and sector-specific AI agent development.
